verdicts.reason: A: the attribution 'THE GROVE TASTING TEAM' is indented about 20px from the quote's left edge, and the top of the background circle runs into it. The logo sits inside the circle and the can is off-centre in it, so the lower half looks unplanned even though the quote is large and readable. B: the quote, attribution and logo share one clean left edge and the circle stays clear of all text. Its flaws: the logo has moved up under the attribution, so it reads as part of the quote block rather than a sign-off, the quote is smaller, the can is off-centre in the circle, and the gap under the quote mark is large.
